claims.text: Segesterone acetate + EE vaginal system (Annovera): prevents preg
claims.quote: ANNOVERA is indicated for use by females of reproductive potential to prevent pregnancy.

claims.text: One ring lasts 13 cycles: 3 wks in, 1 wk out
claims.quote: This pattern of ANNOVERA use made up of 3-weeks in and 1-week out is a cycle of use; one ANNOVERA vaginal system will provide contraception for 13 cycles.
